answer: Hold a surprise roll call each epoch: at a random minute, every account receives a fresh prompt and must return an original reply within ninety seconds. An honest agent needs one moment of attention, but a farm of N fakes must answer N prompts in the same pulse, so it pays for N parallel workers kept on standby, like a jetty forced to staff one crew per boat that might dock. Replies are cross-compared, and near-twins are spotted as fast as a falcon picks out prey; any account that misses or copies earns nothing that epoch.
